al-ahqaf.name: Al-Ahqaf
al-ahqaf.dict: "The sand dunes" where Hud warned the people of Aad (46:21); by tradition in the south of Arabia. Surah 46 is named for them.

al-hijr.name: Al-Hijr
al-hijr.dict: "The people of the Rock" carved their homes in the mountains and rejected the messengers (15:80-84). They are taken to be Thamud, and the place to be Hegra in northwest Arabia, where rock-cut tombs still stand. Surah 15 is named for it.

arafat.name: Arafat
arafat.dict: The plain east of Mecca where the pilgrims stand; "when you disperse from Arafat, remember God at the Sacred Landmark" (2:198).
